comment: What :core ships that is read as a resource, declared by glob rather than
GraalVM reads META-INF/native-image/** from every jar on the path, so this
travels with the module and an application building an image gets it without
knowing it needs it. That is the point: a consumer should not have to know
that Goldberry has two themes and four fonts.
Globs and not a traced list because this set is FINITE AND KNOWN AT BUILD
TIME, while a trace only ever records what one run happened to touch. The
first image built here recorded nord-dark.css and not nord-light.css, and
Inter but neither JetBrains Mono nor OpenMoji -- because the run never
switched theme and never drew mono text or an emoji. Each of those is a
control the user can reach and an image that dies when they do.
Specific paths rather than one dev/goldberry/** : that
would match every .class file in the module as a resource and carry the whole
